description: This donut chart, from the paper “The Evolution of Darija Open Dataset Introducing Version 2,” visually represents the distribution of data categories within the dataset, showing five distinct segments corresponding to the categories listed in the legend: “Moroccan Names” (orange), “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” (purple), “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” (brownish-orange), “Extra + Augmented Data” (blue-gray), and “Pending Translations” (light green). Each segment is labeled with its numerical value: “Pending Translations” accounts for 43,000, “Extra + Augmented Data” for 30,000, “Syntactic Roles” for 23,108, and “Extra + Augmented Data” for 45,387. The smallest segment, “Semantic Categories,” is not numerically labeled but is visually represented as a thin purple slice. The chart includes a legend on the right side that maps each color to its respective category, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest segment (“Extra + Augmented Data”) appearing at the bottom and the smallest (“Semantic Categories”) at the top. The chart has a white center hole, giving it a donut shape, and no percentages are shown, though the absolute values suggest the “Extra + Augmented Data” category is the largest, followed by “Pending Translations,” then “Extra + Augmented Data,” then “Syntactic Roles,” and finally “Semantic Categories.”
